body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/32204

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2231

Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2130

Independent review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2191

## What changed

This preserves the candidate's valid Qwen3.5/Qwen3-VL terminal capture fix and consolidates the three concrete counterexamples from independent review:

- Qwen2Model and inherited Qwen3Model now append the terminal decoder output when capture position `num_layers` is requested.
- Qwen3.5 terminal capture now consumes the pre-normalization residual stream returned by finalization. This avoids adding `Qwen35MoeFinalizeHandoff` to a tensor before FlashInfer MNNVL deferred finalization.
- Repeated Qwen3.5 capture configuration validates first and clears obsolete `_is_layer_to_capture` flags before applying the new selection.

The candidate's retained log also had one trailing-whitespace line; this PR removes it so the full base-to-head diff passes `git diff --check`.

## Failing before / passing after

Against exact candidate commit `8b5ab59b905622ea414746c75e1f70dc4065c928`, the focused counterexample selection failed with:

- stale Qwen3.5 layer flags;
- Qwen2 and Qwen3 returning only the final tensor for terminal position 3;
- `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'Qwen35MoeFinalizeHandoff' and 'Tensor'`.

Raw candidate-before output is in `reports/j-12a46bce4323/raw/failing_before.log`.

After the correction:

- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_5_dflash_capture.py` — 8 passed, including 2 Qwen2/Qwen3 subtests.
- isort, ruff, ruff-format, registered-test validation, and full base-to-head `git diff --check` passed.
- One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`) check confirmed the captured GPU residual stream exactly matched an independent CPU reference; raw output is retained under the report.

## Limitations

Qwen3.5-4B weights, Ascend hardware, and a multi-node FlashInfer MNNVL environment were unavailable. I therefore do not claim a full serving/model, Ascend, semantic-accuracy, or distributed-workload reproduction. The deferred-finalization regression uses the actual `Qwen35MoeFinalizeHandoff` type and model forward branch with a deterministic fake finalizer. The GPU check validates only the device-independent terminal residual-stream boundary. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
